# Where Fūjin works now: the myths behind the markets
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Fūjin** shows up constantly.

Fūjin's mythology is grounded in the creation narratives of the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki, in popular Buddhist iconography, and in the visual tradition of Japanese screen painting. He is both a primordial force and a temple guardian.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Fūjin
- **Pantheon:** Japanese
- **Domain of influence:** Wind
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Technology & Innovation · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Wind & Atmospheric Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 81 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Birth of Fūjin.** The wind kami are older than the name Fūjin.  In the Kojiki's birth-of-the-kami sequence, Shinatsuhiko-no-mikoto, the wind deity, is born to Izanagi and Izanami among the elemental gods that follow the making of the islands. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**Wind in the Age of the Gods.** The wind kami appear in several episodes of the divine age.  When the sun goddess Amaterasu withdrew into the cave, the winds stilled and the world grew dark. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Wind & Atmospheric Energy

*Wind farms, turbines, and atmospheric resource management. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The wind-bag on his shoulders holds every gale; when he opens it, forests tear and roofs scatter — Japan’s wind made kami.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Aviation & Aerospace

*Flight, aerospace engineering, and the sky economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*He carries the winds of the world in his bag; every flight plan reads his moods.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Manga, anime, and games cast him as overwhelming natural force; the wind-bag is a global shorthand.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Music, Arts & Performance

*Music, theatre, dance, and the performing arts. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Sōtatsu's Fūjin-Raijin screens are national treasures; his image is art history's own icon.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Typhoons and seasonal winds are still spoken of in his name; the gale is his dataset.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Fūjin's mythology is grounded in the creation narratives of the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki, in popular Buddhist iconography, and in the visual tradition of Japanese screen painting. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in wind & atmospheric energy, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/fujin/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
